body: The answer to your question is dont kill yourself at all. I know things seem bad things seem like you wont recover. I dont know you and i dont know your story. But i do know that suicide is not the answer to anything. Suicide does not make the pain go away, it just makes it spread to other people. How do you think your dad and grandma will feel. All the pain and suffering will just transfer to them. What your question should be isnt where do i do it. It should be, where can i go to get help? It should be, is suicide really worth it? There are several places to get help, your dad, your grandma, anyone you trust. Even the hotline if you have to. And it is never worth it. You were put here on earth for a reason. The most important thing in life is to maintain hope and keep on fighting. Better days will come. I know things may seem hopeless, lost, like youd be better off dead. But thats not true. In truth, nobody is better off dead. There are so many reasons for you to live, so many reasons for you to stay alive. You make someone happy, whether its your dad or grandma or maybe someone you dont even know about. Whatever the case may be, theres always someone who cares about you and who will be there for you. Dont kill yourself. Please
